CustomField.label: Attended
CustomField.description: ★R6 This person actually turned up. Deliberately a separate fact from Status__c = Approved: approval is permission to come, attendance is having come, and an approved no-show is exactly the row that would poison a recommendation built on "events attended". Nothing sets this automatically — an AM records it after the event from the All Invitees tab, so an event nobody marks up simply has no attendance data rather than false attendance data.
